title: Presentations
ringkas: Membuka, transisi, menjelaskan slide, dan tanya jawab
goals: menyusun presentasi dengan struktur **pembuka, isi, dan penutup**
membuka presentasi: menyapa, memperkenalkan diri, topik, dan garis besar
memakai **signposting** (penanda transisi): [[Let's move on to ...]], [[Turning to ...]], [[As you can see ...]]
menjelaskan slide, grafik, dan poin penting dengan jelas
menutup presentasi dan menangani sesi **tanya jawab**
berbicara dengan jelas, mengatur tempo, dan mengurangi rasa gugup

lesson.text: Presentasi di kantor bukan soal membaca slide, melainkan **menyampaikan pesan** supaya pendengar paham dan bertindak. Presentasi yang baik punya struktur sederhana: **Katakan apa yang akan kamu katakan, katakan, lalu ulangi apa yang sudah kamu katakan.**

lesson.title: 1. Struktur presentasi
table: [[Good morning, everyone. My name is Dina, and today I'll talk about ...]]
[[I'll cover three points: first, ... second, ... and finally, ...]]
[[I'd be happy to take any questions.]]

lesson.title: 2. Membuka presentasi
table: [[Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here.]]
[[Let me introduce myself. I'm Dina, from the Sales team.]]
[[Today I'd like to talk about ...]] / [[The topic of my presentation is ...]]
[[The aim of this presentation is to ...]]
[[I've divided my talk into three parts.]]
[[Please feel free to interrupt.]] / [[There will be time for questions at the end.]]

lesson.title: 3. Signposting: transisi antarbagian
table: [[Let's move on to ...]] / [[Turning to ...]] / [[Now let me turn to ...]]
[[For example, ...]] / [[Let me give you an example.]]
[[The key point is ...]] / [[What I want to stress is ...]]
[[As you can see on this slide, ...]] / [[This chart shows ...]]
[[That brings me to the end of this section.]]

items.ex: Please look at the next slide.
My first point is about cost.
The aim is to reduce costs.
I want to stress this point.
We have a Q&A at the end.

lesson.title: 5. Menutup dan tanya jawab
table: [[To summarise, ...]] / [[Let me quickly go over the main points.]]
[[Thank you for your attention.]] / [[That's all from me. Thank you.]]
[[Are there any questions?]] / [[I'd be glad to answer any questions.]]
[[That's a good question.]] / [[Thank you for asking.]]
[[I'm afraid I don't have that figure with me. I'll get back to you.]]
[[That's outside the scope of today's talk, but I'd be happy to discuss it later.]]

lesson.title: Tips tampil percaya diri
lesson.text: **Berlatihlah** dengan suara keras, atur **tempo** (jangan terburu-buru), jeda sejenak setelah poin penting, jaga **kontak mata**, dan satu slide untuk satu pesan. Tarik napas dalam sebelum mulai agar tidak gugup.

lines.en: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. My name is Dina, and I'm from the Sales team.
lines.id: Selamat pagi semuanya. Terima kasih sudah hadir. Nama saya Dina, dari tim Penjualan.

lines.en: Today I'd like to talk about our sales results for the first half of the year. I've divided my talk into three parts: the results, the problems, and the plan.
lines.id: Hari ini saya ingin membahas hasil penjualan kami untuk semester pertama. Saya membagi presentasi menjadi tiga bagian: hasil, masalah, dan rencana.

lines.en: Let's begin with the results. As you can see on this slide, sales rose steadily until April.
lines.id: Mari mulai dengan hasilnya. Seperti terlihat di slide ini, penjualan naik stabil hingga April.

lines.en: That brings me to the end of this part. Now let me turn to the problems.
lines.id: Itu mengakhiri bagian ini. Sekarang saya beralih ke masalahnya.

lines.en: To sum up, sales are growing, but delivery is slow. I recommend adding two drivers.
lines.id: Singkatnya, penjualan tumbuh, tetapi pengiriman lambat. Saya merekomendasikan menambah dua pengemudi.

lines.en: Thank you for your attention. I'd be happy to take any questions.
lines.id: Terima kasih atas perhatian Anda. Saya senang menjawab pertanyaan apa pun.

lines.en: Thank you, Dina. How much would the two drivers cost?
lines.id: Terima kasih, Dina. Berapa biaya dua pengemudi itu?

lines.en: That's a good question. I'm afraid I don't have the exact figure with me, but I'll send it to you by this afternoon.
lines.id: Itu pertanyaan bagus. Sayangnya saya tidak membawa angka pastinya, tetapi akan saya kirim sore ini.

items: Struktur: **opening → outline → body → summary → closing → Q&A**.
Signposting: [[Let's move on to ...]], [[Turning to ...]], [[As you can see ...]].
Menutup: [[To sum up, ...]], [[Thank you for your attention.]]
Tanya jawab: [[That's a good question.]]; jika tidak tahu: [[I'll get back to you.]]
Latih, atur tempo, jaga kontak mata, satu slide satu pesan.

read.id:
Selamat pagi semuanya. Terima kasih sudah hadir. Nama saya Rani, dari tim Pemasaran. Hari ini saya akan mempresentasikan rencana kami untuk kuartal berikutnya. Presentasi saya terdiri atas tiga bagian. Pertama, saya akan meninjau hasil kami saat ini. Kedua, saya akan memperkenalkan kampanye baru kami. Terakhir, saya akan menjelaskan anggaran.
Presentasi ini sekitar lima belas menit, dan akan ada waktu untuk pertanyaan di akhir. Mari kita mulai dengan slide pertama, yang menunjukkan penjualan kami sejauh tahun ini.

read.text:
Good morning, everyone. Thank you for coming. My name is Rani, and I'm from the Marketing team. Today I'm going to present our plan for the next quarter. My presentation has three parts. First, I'll review our current results. Second, I'll introduce our new campaign. Finally, I'll explain the budget.
It should take about fifteen minutes, and there will be time for questions at the end. Let's begin with the first slide, which shows our sales so far this year.

Sekarang, mari kita lihat grafik ini. Seperti yang Anda lihat, jumlah pesanan daring telah berlipat ganda sejak Januari. Garis biru mewakili pesanan dari aplikasi seluler, dan garis oranye mewakili pesanan dari situs web.
Yang menarik adalah pesanan seluler tumbuh jauh lebih cepat. Ini menunjukkan bahwa kita sebaiknya berinvestasi lebih banyak pada aplikasi kita. Hal itu membawa saya ke slide berikutnya. Apakah ada pertanyaan sejauh ini?

read.text:
Now, let's look at this graph. As you can see, the number of online orders has doubled since January. The blue line represents orders from mobile apps, and the orange line represents orders from the website.
What's interesting is that mobile orders have grown much faster. This suggests that we should invest more in our app. That brings me to my next slide. Does anyone have any questions so far?

read.text:
Good afternoon, everyone. My name is Rani, and today I'm going to present our new customer survey. I will start with the results, and then I will explain what we plan to do next.
As you can see on this slide, customer satisfaction has increased by ten percent this year. To sum up, our service is improving, but we still need to reduce waiting time. Thank you for your attention. I'll be happy to answer any questions.

read.id:
Terima kasih atas perhatian Anda semua. Singkatnya, kita telah mencapai tiga tujuan tahun ini: penjualan tumbuh dua belas persen, keluhan pelanggan menurun, dan aplikasi baru telah diluncurkan.
Tahun depan, kita akan fokus pada dua prioritas. Pertama, kita akan berekspansi ke tiga kota baru. Kedua, kita akan meningkatkan program pelatihan. Jika Anda punya pertanyaan, silakan bertanya sekarang. Setelah sesi, saya akan mengirim slide saya ke semua orang lewat email.

Pasangkan ungkapan penutup dengan fungsinya:

qs.answer: Next year, we will focus on two priorities.

read.text:
Thank you all for your attention. To sum up, we have achieved three goals this year: sales have grown by twelve percent, customer complaints have fallen, and the new app has been launched.
Next year, we will focus on two priorities. First, we will expand to three new cities. Second, we will improve our training program. If you have any questions, please ask now. After the session, I will send my slides to everyone by email.
